_comment: Manual curation for tool 'families' where the raw show-notes extraction produced many near-duplicate/noise entries for what's really one product (blog posts, GitHub issues, NixOS-deployment writeups, docker-compose examples, etc all mentioning the same core tool). Two mechanisms: 'merge' folds a noisy name variant into a canonical entry (its episode mentions are absorbed, it stops existing as its own row). 'families' groups genuinely distinct sub-products/apps under a shared parent for display (each keeps its own entry, but the site nests them under the parent instead of showing them as flat top-level rows when both match a search). 'overrides' forces clean name/url/description/category on a canonical entry instead of the usual best-of-the-raw-variants heuristic. Add more families here as other duplicated products are found - this file is the whole mechanism, no code changes needed to extend it.

nextcloud.name: Nextcloud
nextcloud.description: Self-hosted file sync, calendar, contacts, and office/collaboration suite. Runs bare (NixOS module, Docker, or from source) for just the core server, or via Nextcloud AIO for a batteries-included bundle with more apps and stronger defaults out of the box.

nextcloud-aio.name: Nextcloud AIO
nextcloud-aio.description: Nextcloud's official All-in-One Docker deployment — bundles the core server with commonly-used apps (Office, Talk, backups) and hardened defaults, versus configuring each piece yourself on a bare install.

nextcloud notes.name: Nextcloud Notes
nextcloud notes.description: Nextcloud's official Notes app — plain-text/Markdown notes stored in your Nextcloud files and synced across devices.

smokeping.name: SmokePing
smokeping.description: SmokePing keeps track of your network latency, packet loss, and jitter over time with RRD-graphed history.

home assistant.name: Home Assistant
home assistant.description: Open-source home automation platform that puts local control and privacy first. Formerly branded Hass.io for the OS/supervisor image; Home Assistant Cloud (Nabu Casa) and HACS (community add-on/integration store) are separate official companion products.
